resources.string: The host must run with administrator privileges.
The SANs do not cover every binding. Wildcards cover one DNS label only.
Metadata coverage does not prove live HTTPS or client trust.
This certificate is not valid yet.
Server PEM paths: expiry and SAN coverage are unverified here.
Saved certificate %1$s is missing. Select another certificate explicitly.
Select a certificate before saving HTTPS.
This certificate status cannot be deployed.
Certificate metadata is unavailable. Refresh before changing the binding.
Request cancellation and then query the task result?
Cancellation does not prove issuance, revocation or deletion was rolled back. Inspect certificate facts afterwards.
Direct HTTP-01 binds host port 80. Webroot HTTP-01 requires an existing working Nginx ACME include. Neither opens the firewall or proves public reachability.
Delete host certificate metadata and protected material? Kestrel selection is removed. This does not revoke the certificate at its issuer or delete sites.

Replace the server HTTPS certificate? The selected certificate becomes the default, and SNI names follow its SANs. Confirm coverage of your management address and verify the new fingerprint. Self-signed certificates require renewed client trust confirmation. New connections use the new material; existing connections may retain old material. If the management connection breaks, recover the original operation and check its status.
Certificate is absent from the live selector.
Server observation only. It does not prove a public frontend or client trust, or the outcome of a lost request. Recover the original operation ID or retry with the original key.
Runtime fingerprint matches the current metadata.
Runtime material differs from current metadata.
Refresh metadata and Kestrel facts; valid material and an HTTPS listener are required.
Certificate is registered in the live selector.
SNI certificate; other hosts use the default fallback.
Certificate detail is unavailable or the record is missing.
Discard the in-memory form? A pending server request remains available for verification.
DNS-01 is unavailable in the current server. No DNS tokens are collected.
Domains / SANs (separated by space or comma)
Validity period has ended. Verify dependent services before use.
Expires within 30 days. Review renewal and linked deployments.
To replace the server HTTPS certificate, open Settings → System → Server HTTPS.
Manage certificate metadata on the server. Keys and PEM remain on the host.
The original operation record is missing. Inspect certificate facts before creating a new request.
Issuer or challenge validation failed. Review public DNS/HTTP and server diagnostics.
ACME contact email is invalid or unavailable.
Host DNS lookup failed or returned no addresses.
The server rejected certificate input. Review names, challenge, key and validity.
Server restart interrupted this task. Inspect facts before submitting a new request.
Kestrel HTTPS binding or activation is unavailable.
Protected certificate material is unavailable or its path is unsafe.
The original certificate record is missing; verify the original operation.
Host port 80 is unavailable. Check its listener and host privileges.
Public HTTP reachability must be explicitly confirmed.
Self-signed certificates cannot use ACME renewal or revocation.
Accept the issuer terms before submission.
Certificate operation could not be completed. Query its record and host facts.
I confirm all domains reach this host on public HTTP port 80.
DNS and host checks do not prove reachability from the issuer or from the phone. Confirm external HTTP access separately.
Unable to read certificate information. Check the connection and refresh; your draft is retained.
Enter the original server operation ID. For a pending request, confirm this is its original task; matching domains alone are insufficient.
Renew this certificate? Linked host deployments may also change.
Automatic renewal is disabled (revoked or missing ACME contact email).
Automatic renewal is enabled. The server checks daily and renews within the renewal window.
%1$s consecutive failures. Automatic retries are paused; resolve the cause and renew manually.
Retry allowed after: %1$s; execution waits for the next server scan.
Select a certificate to view renewal records.
Self-signed certificates do not renew automatically. Create and replace the certificate before expiry.
Renewal records unavailable. Refresh to try again.
A creation request remains unverified. After restarting, re-enter exactly the original form to retry its key, or recover its original operation ID.
Read host facts, then retry the original action with its original request key. A missing certificate does not prove the original task succeeded.
Revoke this certificate at its issuer? Host Kestrel selection is removed. Existing sites and clients may lose trusted TLS access.
Self-signed certificates require separate client trust. Creating one does not enable HTTPS or make it publicly trusted.
Submit this certificate request to the host? It may create protected certificate material and contact the configured issuer.
Issue, inspect and manage host certificates
I accept the configured ACME issuer terms.
Certificate list could not be verified.
Result is unverified. Query the original task before retrying; no request is replayed automatically.
Check identifiers, key algorithm and validity. ACME also requires email, accepted terms and HTTP reachability confirmation.
